purpose: Prevent long tool-heavy production turns from completing work without delivering a visible final response, while preserving durable resumability across ChatGPT, Codex and Work.

turn_boundary.rule: After a major stage/milestone reaches PASS, BLOCKED, or another durable resume boundary, persist it and send the user a final response before starting the next major stage.
turn_boundary.allowed_same_turn_continuation: Small cleanup/verification needed to make the current milestone durable is allowed. Do not silently roll into the next major stage.
turn_boundary.user_override: The user may explicitly request multi-stage execution, but the tool budget and intermediate-checkpoint rules still apply.

tool_budget.action_at_soft_budget: Stop at the next safe durable boundary, persist state, and answer the user.
tool_budget.hard_rule: Do not exceed the hard budget unless stopping would risk losing already-produced work; create an intermediate checkpoint first whenever possible.
tool_budget.retry_rule: After one corrected retry, record PENDING/BLOCKED and answer instead of entering a retry loop.

context_budget.rule: Read only relevant keys/ranges/files when possible. Avoid dumping very large PROJECT-STATE/README/checkpoint files into context when a targeted read or parsed summary is sufficient.
context_budget.large_output_rule: If a tool response is truncated or very large, switch to targeted retrieval instead of repeatedly requesting the whole resource.

persistence.git: Source, small metadata, manifests, hashes, policy, checkpoint summaries and durable coordination state
persistence.git_failure_rule: Respect bounded Git retry policy; mark persistence PENDING when needed and preserve the exact artifact/hash/resume point.

runtime_currentness.rule: Re-resolve CURRENT whenever runtime compatibility matters. Never inherit an old runtime from a content checkpoint merely because it was current when that checkpoint was written.

must_include: exact checkpoint/artifact or durable state location when applicable
final_response_contract.anti_pattern: Do not end a production turn after tool calls without a user-visible final response when a safe response can be sent.

resume_rule: A new chat/agent resumes from bootstrap + currentness/pins + PROJECT-STATE + relevant CHECKPOINT, not from reconstructing long chat history.
